title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence
summary: Given an integer array nums, return the count of the longest strictly increasing subsequences.
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the count of the longest strictly increasing subsequences.
constraints: Count distinct index subsequences having maximum strictly increasing length.
hints: Each position needs both its best increasing length and how many ways achieve that length.
Extend every earlier smaller value and either replace or add its contribution.
On a longer candidate copy its count; on an equal candidate add its count; sum counts at global max length.
Index-distinct predecessors define disjoint subsequence sets, so equal best contributions add.
editorial: Index-distinct predecessors define disjoint subsequence sets, so equal best contributions add.

tests.explanation: The longest subsequences end through either three-five-seven or three-four-seven, giving two.
Each individual position is a distinct longest subsequence, giving five.
